findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 25 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 14 questions numbered 1-14; by section: u-introduction-functional-groups-in-synthesis 1, 25.1 4, u-functional-group-interconversion 1, 25.2 3, 25.3 3, 25.4 2.

14 four-mark theory parts (the chapter teaches no numericals) covering functional groups in synthesis, the features of a good synthesis, synthesis of amines in one and two steps, retrosynthesis and the disconnection approach, the terminology of retrosynthesis, FGI, the retrosynthesis and synthesis of ethyl acetate, aniline and acetophenone, the reasoning behind the paracetamol route, a paracetamol-aspirin comparison, and AI in drug designing (halicin). The exercise's descriptive and constructed-response questions are approached from different angles (reasons, comparisons) rather than repeated. Book corrections followed: ethyl acetate SE acetic acid + ethanol; paracetamol Step IV on 4-nitrophenol (HO–C₆H₄⁻ + NO₂⁺), Step V SE phenol + nitric acid; pathogens become resistant; sulfur in halicin's rings.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
